subject: Life Skills
title: How to Unclog a Drain
description: A fast breakdown of How to Unclog a Drain for builders.

hook.text: Chemical drain cleaners can corrode pipes and cause more damage than the original clog.

buildup.text: Most clogs form from hair and soap buildup sitting just inches below the drain opening.

discovery.text: A bent wire hanger or a simple drain snake can pull out the clog physically without any chemicals.

twist.text: Baking soda and vinegar fizz impressively but barely dissolve real blockages. It's mostly a visual effect.

climax.text: Pour boiling water weekly as prevention. For real clogs, use a plunger or snake before calling a plumber.

punchline.text: A two-dollar snake beats a chemical bottle.

quiz.question: Why are chemical drain cleaners problematic?
options: They only work on small clogs
They can corrode and damage pipes
They take too long to work
